g.text: Normalize the auxiliary middle identity words
The total two-sided differential preserves the degeneracies.
X̄_F = X_F / D_mid
D_mid: middle words containing a literal s1_B
1_V = E_ee + E_ff + E_yy
sE_yy = −sE_ee − sE_ff
root: 9 coefficients middle: 8 letters last: 9 coefficients
Original parameter/source bars and all output coefficients remain.
Raw insertion is now already a special contraction
D h̄ + h̄ D = 1 − s q
h̄² = h̄ s = q h̄ = 0
An ordinary higher identity output is still an action
G = Φ c = sE_ef | sE_ye
τ_G(c) = 1_V
This term acts on the last coefficient; it is not a middle input.
A nullary coefficient category can have no positive middle letters
while retaining its entire IC₀ output complex.
Total differential and normalization: Theorem 27. Exact cases: Exercise 27.
Free module background: Keller, arXiv:math/9910179, §4.2.
All original operator labels remain; multiple-graft tree equations are separate.
